versions.changelog:
ai-powered-literature-review-skills v3.0.1

- Added SECURITY.md to outline security policies and best practices.
- Introduced docker-compose.yml for streamlined containerized deployment.
- Added install.yaml and mcp.json for improved installation and configuration management.
- No changes to user-facing workflow or output format; infrastructure files only.

Version 3.0.0 introduces a comprehensive and automated 8-phase academic literature review workflow with improved Chinese and English support.

- Adds an 8-stage workflow covering query analysis, browser-based parallel search (no API required), deduplication, verification, data export, deep article analysis, citation formatting, and structured synthesis.
- Automates data collection from CNKI, Web of Science, ScienceDirect, PubMed, and Google Scholar via browser automation.
- Supports both Chinese and English literature, with standardized outputs including GB/T 7714-2015 citations, abstracts, and Markdown documentation.
- Includes structured AI prompt templates for keyword generation, article analysis, and review outline creation.
- Triggers literature review when users mention relevant keywords in Chinese.
